ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to expand my existing door alarms into camera coverage with Alexa integration.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought a second-generation Show 5 and its stand, so this older version adds little.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a newer fourth-generation Dot and do not currently need another older speaker.
ItemID: NA; Title: All-new Fire HD 10 tablet, 10.1", 1080p Full HD, 32 GB, latest model (2021 release), Black, without lockscreen ads; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try a larger portable screen for entertainment alongside my Fire TV and Alexa devices.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger screen interests me, but I would choose the newer 2021 tablet on this page.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The clock is useful, but it overlaps heavily with the fourth-generation Dot I recently bought.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The bigger display appeals to me, but I am still setting up my recently purchased Show 5.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Fire HD 8 tablet, 8" HD display, 64 GB, (2020 release), designed for portable entertainment, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Portable entertainment fits my interests, but I would pick the larger 2021 HD 10 this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa-compatible monitoring interests me, but I would start with the whole-home bundle before adding three indoor cameras.
